what_this_is: A record of the vision passes actually run on the A3 files, in order, with what each pass reported. A vision read is evidence, never a verification: every geometric, colour and hash claim is taken from scripts/cp012-cover-accept.py and scripts/cp012-provenance.py, which measure the bytes.

passes.asked: objects seen; any lettering/number/label; light direction; flat gouache on warm paper; defects
passes.reported: Japanese: lantern, noren, counter, cup with steam, two stools. Parent: jug, bowl with spoon, two oranges, plum cloth, wooden board. Technical: open book, stack of papers, brown parcel, wooden desk. No lettering in any panel; upper-left light in all three; flat gouache on warm paper; no gradient, shadow or border.
passes.verdict: all three raws admitted to prep

passes.asked: one kit: paper, saturation family, line weight, light; any plate muddy or synthetic
passes.reported: Consistent warm ivory paper, muted earthy saturation family, consistent dark-brown outline weight, upper-left light in all three. No plate muddy; the middle plate's lavender cloth is the only slightly synthetic hue and is a small accent. Each reads at thumbnail as a distinct subject.

passes.asked: what the bright green is; numbers/ticks on the jug; palette; where the form sits
passes.reported: Green is the orange stems only. The jug is blank: no graduations, numbers or ticks. Forms sit in the lower third, upper right is quiet paper. Oranges read as the most saturated element.
passes.verdict: no measurement claim in art; saturation answered by the shared 97,78,100 temper (V4)

passes.target: the three masters after the 97,78,100 temper
passes.asked: is any plate too muddy, or still synthetic in hue
passes.reported: No plate muddy; muted earthy palette with the oranges now in the ochre family; the lavender cloth is the only small accent.

passes.asked: does each crop keep the key motifs without an awkward cut
passes.reported: Japanese keeps the cup and the counter, cuts only frame elements. Parent keeps jug and bowl; the right orange and the cloth bleed. Technical keeps the open book; the parcel and stack bleed. All legible.
passes.verdict: mechanical centre crop is the delivered 4:5

passes.target: the leftmost 200 px of each master
passes.asked: does an object touch or get clipped by the left edge
passes.reported: Japanese: nothing touches the left edge. Parent and technical: the table plane bleeds to the left edge in the lower third, but no subject object is clipped.
passes.verdict: full-bleed ground is intended; no clipped subject. The left-4%-clear rule belongs to the H-197 Press Plate lane, not to a painted 3:2 plate shown in a card window, and is not asserted here.

refutations.claim: V2 described the contours as bold black outlines.
refutations.measurement: scripts/cp012-cover-accept.py counts pixels within 6 % of pure black: japanese 0.017 %, parent 0.000 %, technical 0.002 % of the frame.
refutations.conclusion: The contour is warm brown, not black; the vision wording was loose and the pixel count is the record. The ART-BIBLE forbids a black contour; the shipped plates do not carry one.

not_claimed: no human illustrator, native-speaker or colour-professional review exists
no claim that these plates read at 64 px; only the 240 px card cell was inspected
no owner approval: the contact sheet is submitted unsigned
